## Overview

- **Name**: CRM IAP Lead Enrichment
- **Description**: Enriches CRM leads with company data via IAP (In-App Purchase) Clearbit service using email domain lookup
- **Location**: `addons/crm_iap_enrich` — 3 model files, 2 config files, tests
- **Language**: Python (Odoo ORM)
- **Purpose**: Automatically or manually triggers enrichment of lead records (name, location, contact info, country, state) based on email domain lookup through the IAP Reveal service
